name: Napoleon
summary: A fast 5-card bidding and trick-taking game where players bet on how many tricks they can win.
rules_text: Deal five cards to each player from a 52-card deck in batches of 3 then 2. Rank A high to 2 low. Starting left of dealer, each player may bid once or pass. A bid is the number of tricks (1-5) the player claims they will win; bidding 5 is called Nap. Highest bid wins. The bidder leads first and that lead suit is trump, must lead a trump. In trick play players must follow the led suit if possible, otherwise may trump or discard. Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped, then highest trump wins. Winner leads next trick. Five tricks are played. Scoring: no bonus for extra tricks. If bidder makes at least their bid, each other player pays the bidder; if bidder fails, bidder pays each opponent. Usually played with chips for a pot.
